title: The Carter-Ashley Room Mix-Up, A Weekend on Tina's Daybed in Luray, & Graduating for Good
description: When Carter-Ashley Hall's room assignments are mysteriously scrambled and Center red tape forces staff to blindly follow the printout, Nate rescues Katie from Chris, neither twin sleeps a wink after learning what Chris did to Natalie, everyone is disgusted when Chris is merely kicked out and the incident is swept under the rug instead of handed to the police, and a weekend sharing Tina's daybed in Luray gives Katie and Nate the strength to finish their PHP certificates and go home.
